text: Cheonmachong under construction, Gyeongju: stone-mound wooden-chamber tomb. Wooden outer chamber 6.6 x 4.2 m, coffin inside, river stones piled above and around the chamber, earth mound finishing at about 47 m diameter and 12.7 m height. Layer order: coffin and grave-goods chest, wooden chamber, stones, earth. Do not invent stone-pile thickness, work duration, headcount or ritual order.
